DEED OF PUBLIC CHARITABLE TRUST

​THIS DEED OF TRUST is made at [City, State] on this [Day] of [Month], 20[Year].

​1. PARTIES

​BY AND BETWEEN

Shri [Name of Founder], son of [Father's Name], aged about [Number] years, resident of [Full Address] (hereinafter referred to as the "Founder", which expression shall unless it be repugnant to the context or meaning thereof be deemed to mean and include his heirs, executors, and administrators) of the FIRST PART;

​AND

AND WHEREAS the Trustees have consented to act as the first trustees of the said Trust.

​3. CONSTITUTION OF THE TRUST

​The Founder hereby settles the property and sum described in the Schedule (the "Trust Fund") upon the Trustees to hold the same in Trust for the purposes hereinafter expressed. The Trust shall be known as "[Name of Trust]".

​4. OBJECTS OF THE TRUST

​The main objects for which this Trust is established are:

​Accept donations, grants, and contributions in cash or kind from the public or government.

​8. MEETINGS AND DECISION MAKING

​The Trustees shall meet at least once every quarter. All matters shall be decided by a majority of votes. In the event of a tie, the Chairman (to be elected by the Trustees) shall have a casting vote.

​10. MAINTENANCE OF ACCOUNTS AND AUDIT

​10. MAINTENANCE OF ACCOUNTS AND AUDIT

​The Trustees shall maintain regular and accurate accounts of all receipts and expenditures. The accounts shall be audited annually by a Chartered Accountant appointed by the Board.

​11. CUSTODY OF DOCUMENTS

​All title deeds, fixed deposit receipts, and other important documents belonging to the Trust shall remain in the safe custody of the Managing Trustee or as decided by the Board.

​12. APPOINTMENT OF NEW TRUSTEES

​12. APPOINTMENT OF NEW TRUSTEES

​In the event of a Trustee resigning, dying, or becoming incapable of acting, the remaining Trustees shall, by a majority vote, appoint a successor to fill the vacancy.

​13. ADVISORY BODY

​The Trustees may constitute an Advisory Body consisting of eminent educationists and philanthropists to advise on the academic and cultural development of the School/College.

​14. UTILIZATION OF INCOME

​14. UTILIZATION OF INCOME

​The income and corpus of the Trust shall be utilized solely for the achievement of the objects of the Trust. No portion of the income shall be paid or transferred directly or indirectly to the Founder or Trustees.

​15. BORROWING POWERS

​The Trustees may borrow money for the purposes of the Trust by mortgaging the Trust properties, provided such borrowing is in the best interest of the educational institutions.

​16. AMENDMENT OF THE DEED

​16. AMENDMENT OF THE DEED

​Any provision of this Deed (except the main objects and the clause on irrevocability) may be amended by a three-fourths majority of the Trustees, subject to approval from the concerned authorities under the Trust Act.

​17. DOCTRINE OF CY-PRES

​If the objects of the Trust become impossible to achieve, the Trustees shall move the appropriate Court to apply the Trust Funds for a similar educational purpose.

​18. INDEMNITY

​18. INDEMNITY

​The Trustees shall be indemnified against all losses and expenses incurred by them in the bona fide discharge of their duties, provided such loss is not caused by their willful neglect or fraud.

​19. VALUATION OF TRUST PROPERTY

​For the purpose of registration and stamp duty, the value of the Trust property settled under this Deed is declared to be Rs. [Amount].

​20. JURISDICTION

​20. JURISDICTION

​This Trust shall be governed by the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 (or the relevant State Public Trust Act). The Courts at [City] shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
